value.abstract_html: A vacuum cleaner tool having a brush head, a rotatable duct, and a hinge. The rotatable duct is configured to receive a hose or wand and rotates about the hinge relative to the brush head, between a use position and storage position. In a storage position, the rotatable duct extends generally parallel, or in-line with the brush head and, in a use position, the rotatable duct extends generally perpendicular to the brush head. The vacuum cleaner tool may removably attach to the vacuum cleaner via a release on one end of the brush head interacting with a fixed catch on the vacuum cleaner.

post.description: Find trademark serial numbers by mark text; for brand screening use `match: phrase` with `status` and `classes` to isolate live marks in the relevant classes. Pass `hits[].serial_number` to `trademark_status` or `assignments`.

alive.description: Older live/dead filter: true is `status: live`, false is `status: dead`. Prefer `status`; when both are given they must agree.

classes.description: Nice international classes; a mark matches when it lists any of them, e.g. `[41]` (education and entertainment) or `[9, 16, 41]` (books and publishing). Classes the registration has since deleted, shown as `(CANCELLED) IC 041`, still match, as on the site.

from.description:
Zero-based offset; pass the previous page's `next_from`.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 9900; default 0.

match.description:
`basic`: the site's basic word-mark search (phrase or any word in the mark, phrase in the pseudo mark). `phrase`: only marks whose word mark or pseudo mark contains the text as a phrase, e.g. `galaxy sports` finds GALAXY SPORTS but not SPORTS GALAXY. Default: `phrase` for a quoted text, else `basic`.

Provider reference: allowed values ["basic", "phrase"].

owner.description: Owner (applicant or registrant) name phrase, matched with up to two words between terms as the site's owner search does, e.g. `samsung electronics`.

size.description:
size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

status.description:
Status filter as the site defines it: `live` (registered or pending), `registered` (live with a registration number), `pending` (live application without one), `dead` (cancelled or abandoned), `cancelled` (dead with a cancellation date), `abandoned` (dead with an abandonment date). Omitted: all.

Provider reference: allowed values ["live", "registered", "pending", "dead", "cancelled", "abandoned"].

text.description: Word mark text to search, e.g. `firecrawl`. Wrapping it in double quotes (`"night hand"`) defaults `match` to `phrase`; the quotes are not sent.

200.description:
Search US trademark applications and registrations by word mark through Trademark Search (tmsearch.uspto.gov). `match: basic` (default) is the site's basic search: the whole phrase or any of its words in the mark, plus the phrase in the pseudo mark, so a multiword text is broad. `match: phrase` (or a text in double quotes) matches only marks whose word mark or pseudo mark contains the words as one phrase. Optional filters narrow by status (live, registered, pending, dead, cancelled, abandoned), Nice class and owner name, the same filters the site offers. One page of hits with serial number, registration number, status, owner, dates, classes and goods/services.

The response contains the tool result directly.
